parameters.content:
## Elevator - Technician Report, Parts & Closure

### How it works

1. Ingests customer elevator issue complaints via webhook and gathers relevant equipment history and specifications from Google Sheets.
2. Triages the reported failure using an AI agent powered by Google Gemini and assigns an available technician matching the issue criteria.
3. Records tickets and updates equipment status in Google Sheets, dispatching technicians via WhatsApp or notifying operations if unavailable.
4. Receives post-repair technician reports via webhook and extracts structured resolution and parts usage data using an AI extraction agent.
5. Appends service records, closes tickets, restores elevator operational status, and resets technician availability.
6. Updates spare parts inventory levels in Google Sheets and sends automated email reorder alerts when inventory drops low.

### Setup steps

- - [ ] Connect Google Sheets credentials and set up spreadsheets for elevators, service logs, technicians, tickets, and parts inventory.
- - [ ] Configure Google Gemini API credentials in the Gemini Chat Model subnodes for triage and data extraction.
- - [ ] Connect WhatsApp Business API credentials to enable technician dispatch notifications.
- - [ ] Connect Gmail credentials to send client confirmations, operational escalations, and inventory reorder alerts.
- - [ ] Set up external forms or ticketing systems to trigger the complaint webhook and technician report webhook URLs.

### Customization

Modify technician assignment algorithms in Assign Technician via Code to incorporate travel distance or certifications. Adjust inventory alert criteria and recipients in Check Inventory Stock and the reorder email node.

## Ingest complaint and elevator history

Receives customer elevator complaints via webhook and fetches matching equipment specifications and maintenance history from Google Sheets.

## Triage elevator issue with AI

Analyzes reported symptoms and historical equipment context using Gemini LLM to determine issue urgency and required skills.

## Match and assign technician

Queries technician availability from Google Sheets and executes custom logic to match the best qualified technician.

## Create ticket and verify assignment

Appends a new service ticket to Google Sheets, sets elevator status to out of order, and verifies assignment success.

## Notify operations of assignment failure

Sends an urgent alert email to the operations team when no technician is available to handle the new ticket.

## Dispatch technician via WhatsApp

Marks the technician as assigned in Google Sheets and sends dispatch assignment details over WhatsApp.

## Confirm dispatch to client

Emails the client confirmation of the dispatched technician and delivers an immediate response to the client webhook.

## Ingest technician service report

Receives completed service reports via webhook and retrieves corresponding ticket information from Google Sheets.

## Fetch inventory and elevator context

Reads equipment details and current spare parts inventory to assemble context for processing the service report.

## Extract service report with AI

Uses Gemini LLM to parse maintenance actions and parts usage from technician notes into structured log entries.

## Log service and close ticket

Appends maintenance details to the service log, marks the ticket closed, and updates the elevator registry to operational.

## Update technician to available

Retrieves technician details tied to the closed ticket and updates their availability status back to available.

## Deliver client completion sign-off

Sends a maintenance sign-off email to the client and acknowledges completion to the webhook caller.

## Update inventory and alert reorders

Deducts used components from inventory in Google Sheets and triggers an email alert if stock falls below minimum levels.

options.systemMessage: You are a dispatch triage expert for an elevator maintenance company. Classify the complaint. severity: P1 = passengers trapped or any safety hazard (free-fall, door open while moving, smoke, injury); P2 = elevator fully out of service; P3 = noise, vibration, cosmetic or minor degraded performance. required_skill: Level 1 = general/doors/lighting; Level 2 = hydraulic or traction/rope/machine issues; Level 3 = controller/electrical/drive faults. Use the service history to spot repeat faults and escalate skill level if the same issue keeps recurring. summary: one sentence technician-ready synopsis.
